bio.text: Paul Barringer is the Democratic nominee for North Carolina's 13th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having won the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.

According to his campaign website, he grew up on a farm in Lee County, manages his family's tree farming operation, and works as a healthcare consultant and as a lawyer representing individuals with disabilities pro bono in Social Security benefit cases.
He attended Davidson College, the University of North Carolina School of Law and Princeton University's School of Public and International Affairs, according to his campaign website.
